Definition: apparently a primary verb; properly, to toil, i.e. (by implication) to tire (figuratively, faint, sicken):--faint, sick, be wearied.
BiblicalUsage: Kamno is to toil, and so to grow weary or to be sick. Hebrews warns us not to be wearied and faint in our minds when we consider Him who endured such contradiction of sinners; and James says the prayer of faith shall save the sick.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that weariness and sickness are both carried to the same place: to Him who endured, and to prayer, which saves the sick.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
